# vpsie_protected_server (Resource)

A server of a connected Migrate source that is protected under a Backup or Disaster-recovery policy. Adding it starts the first copy; pausing and resuming stop and restart the copies; destroying the resource ends the protection, and the platform keeps the recovery points until their immutability locks end. The same server cannot be protected again before then. The policy's tier needs the matching licence module and the account's permission to create.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_protected_server" "db01" {
  policy = vpsie_protect_policy.nightly.identifier
  source = vpsie_migration_source.vcenter.identifier
  vm_ref = "vm-1042"

  # Set to true to pause the copies; back to false to resume them.
  paused = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy` (String) The identifier of an active protection policy (`vpsie_protect_policy`). Changing it replaces the protection and starts a new first copy.
- `source` (String) The identifier of an active Migrate source (`vpsie_migration_source`) whose connector supports protection. Changing it replaces the protection.
- `vm_ref` (String) The server's reference on the source, as the source lists it. Changing it replaces the protection.

### Optional

- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the protection is paused by you. Defaults to `false`. A pause the platform made itself reads as `true` here and cannot be ended from Terraform (see `paused_by`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the protection was created (RFC 3339).
- `identifier` (String) The protected server identifier.
- `name` (String) The server name on the source. Removing the protection needs this name, so it is read from the state at destroy.
- `paused_by` (String) Who paused the protection when it is paused: `tenant` or `platform`.
- `state` (String) The protection state: `pending_approval`, `seeding`, `protected` or `paused`.
- `tier` (String) The tier of the policy: `backup` or `dr`.
